description: Defines an interface 'IWarningReportingMedia' within the WPEFramework::WarningReporting namespace, which declares a virtual destructor and a pure virtual 'Output' method for warning reporting media implementations.

classes.name: IWarningReportingMedia
classes.description: An interface that declares a method for outputting warning event information, intended for implementation by warning media classes.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: A pure virtual method intended to output warning information, requiring implementation in derived classes.

parameters.name: fileName
parameters.description: Name of the source file where the warning was generated

parameters.name: lineNumber
parameters.description: Line number within the source file

parameters.name: identifer
parameters.description: Identifier string for the warning event

parameters.name: information
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWarningEvent object containing warning details
